response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) AS avg_ast_minus_alt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC > 6.5
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) AS avg_of_status_ast_minus_alt,
  AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_of_status_aptt_minus_pt
FROM status_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Using 6.5 as the WBC cutoff” means retaining records with WBC greater than 6.5.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff means WBC at least 6.5, include records equal to 6.5.

  AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) AS avg_of_status_ast_minus_alt,
